data.long_meaning: The name Aru is derived from Sanskrit and translates to 'light'. In Hindu mythology, Aru is a name of the goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, learning, and wisdom. The name Aru carries the meaning “Light” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Aru usually hope their child will grow to embody light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Aru belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aru total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
